title: Diagnostic Fee on a Waiting-Period Re-decision — Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
**Clause.** On a waiting-period re-decision line of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the diagnostic fee reimbursed is set by its credit. The fee is the one charged on the covered concern line, the concern line that carries the repair order's diagnostic fee. The credit is the amount the store credited back against that fee by applying the diagnostic fee to the repair, as shown in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

| Store's credit of the covered concern line's diagnostic fee | Diagnostic fee reimbursed |
|---|---|
| Credited in full | nothing (0.00) |
| Credited in part | the uncredited part of the fee |
| No credit | the whole diagnostic fee |

**Worked cases (hypothetical fee of 139.00).**
- Credit of 139.00: 0.00 reimbursed.
- Credit of 69.50: 139.00 less 69.50, so 69.50 reimbursed.
- No credit: 139.00 reimbursed.
